comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The blue-winged version of this equipment can be obtained from digging the yellow pillar spots in Halicarnassus / Mausoleum at Halicarnassus' Past.

In game stats:
Durability 20/20
Defence Power 10
+1 Mine Laying
+1 Evasion
30000 Total Fame required to equip this.
